design.excluded: none: 3000/3000 clean, zero empty, zero truncated, zero batch errors

normalization.why: generation hygiene flagged 100% markdown and 97% headline-echo title lines (formatting the plain-prose human baseline lacks; guard: experiments/ablation/generation_hygiene.py). The normalizer drops the echoed headline block and unwraps markdown syntax, preserving every word of article prose. Quote style is untouched (the metric maps typographic quotes to ASCII).
normalization.effect: raw scoring understated the authorship gap (markdown scaffolding inflated variance): control B_n delta +0.022 (rb 0.21) raw vs +0.069 (rb 0.58) normalized. Raw scoring archived beside the normalized eval on the dataset.

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/gen_vllm.py (2x A40, TP=2, vLLM offline batching, BENCH_THINKING=0)

provenance: Generated on a rented 2x A40 pod with bench/gen_vllm.py; normalized and scored against the frozen human baseline; the compiled eval is the file in this directory.
